description: Source code for a Zephyr-based network promiscuous mode sample, including functions for packet hexdump, interface configuration, packet info printing, and promiscuous mode control via shell commands.

methods.name: net_pkt_hexdump
methods.description: Dumps packet data in hex for debugging.

methods.name: iface_cb
methods.description: Callback to enable promiscuous mode on network interfaces.

methods.name: get_ports
methods.description: Extracts source and destination ports from UDP packet.

methods.name: print_info
methods.description: Prints detailed info about a network packet, including IP version, protocol, addresses, and ports.

methods.name: set_promisc_mode
methods.description: Enables or disables promiscuous mode on a specified network interface via shell command.

methods.name: cmd_promisc_on
methods.description: Shell command to turn promiscuous mode on.

methods.name: cmd_promisc_off
methods.description: Shell command to turn promiscuous mode off.
